blocks.text: One of the most powerful features of JSX is the ability to embed JavaScript expressions directly within your markup.
You can insert any valid JavaScript expression inside JSX by wrapping it in curly braces { }.
React will evaluate the expression and render the result in the DOM.

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: Variables are also valid expressions. Insert variables in JSX by wrapping it in curly braces { }.

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: Function calls are valid expressions. Insert function calls in JSX by wrapping it in curly braces { }.
